response.overview: Short film made as part of her work at the Cinemateca Portuguesa, in response to a challenge linked to an exhibition at the Theatre Museum and a film series at the Cinemateca, both of which explored the dynamic interplay between theatre and cinema: *Theatre Goes to the Cinema* and *Cinema Goes to the Theatre*.  Made on video, the film features special contributions from Isabel Ruth and Luís Lucas and incorporates a small number of film excerpts. The voices heard in the film include those of Manoel de Oliveira, Luís Miguel Cintra, Miguel Guilherme, Isabel de Castro, Carla Bolito, Paulo Rocha, Manuela de Freitas, Jorge Silva Melo, Marco Delgado, Milú and João Mário Grilo.
response.title: Teatro e Cinema
